exam.agreeText: I have read all instructions and agree to the exam rules.

instrList.i1: Ensure you have a stable internet connection before starting.
instrList.i2: The exam will open in fullscreen mode. Do not exit fullscreen.
instrList.i3: Switching browser tabs will be recorded and may lead to disqualification.
instrList.i4: Your answers are auto-saved every few seconds.
instrList.i5: Do not refresh or close the browser during the exam.
instrList.i6: Once the timer reaches zero, your exam will be submitted automatically.
